Both stacks are clean. Let me record the durable fixes in memory (this is reusable next host swap, and corrects a now-stale note about where issues live).

The local environment is fully restored and running. Here's the rundown.

## ✅ Running locally again

I brought the dev stack up from the **main checkout** (`~/dev/FamilyFund/app1` — it holds the populated `datadir_dev` and the compose-var `.env`):

| Service | URL / Port | Status |
|---|---|---|
| **FamilyFund app** | http://localhost:3001 | ✅ 302→login, dev-login→dashboard 200, funds index 200 |
| MariaDB (dev) | localhost:3306 | ✅ 19 users / 9 funds |
| Mailpit UI | (app1-mailhog) | ✅ healthy |

**Debugging done along the way:**
- This worktree had no env — copied `.env.dev`/`.env.stage` from the main checkout and symlinked `.env`.
- **One migration was pending** (`2026_05_29_000001_create_password_reset_tokens_table`) → applied with `migrate --force`. All migrations now `Ran`. No errors in `laravel.log`.

## 🔧 Fixed the broken preview pool (root-caused a real ticket)

`~/.familyfund-pool/` was half-migrated to the refactored ai-harness layout and **refused to run** (`pool: no config found` / `adapter not found`). I restored the missing symlinks in the state dir: `config.local.yaml`, the `laravel-docker-pool.sh` adapter, and `_yaml_to_env.py` / `pool-core.sh` / `load-config.sh`. Verified end-to-end by leasing slot `pool0` (http://localhost:3020 → dashboard 200 against the shared dev DB), then released it so the pool is clean (6/6 free).

This is **exactly** [`FamilyFund-v2-archive#1` — "Restore mini dev-env runability after public-portfolio split"](https://github.com/jdtogni78/FamilyFund-v2-archive/issues/1), and all its acceptance criteria now pass (pending only the optional SETUP.md doc + narrate-demo hookup).
